title: ESC: Escaping 2D Diffusion Ambiguity with Geometric Constraints for Consistent Novel View Synthesis
title_zh: ESC：利用几何约束逃离2D扩散歧义，实现一致的新视角合成

paragraphs.en: 该研究提出结合深度图联合生成的扩散框架，利用逐像素深度一致性约束实现几何一致的新视角合成。 Generating 3D-consistent novel views from 2D diffusion models remains a fundamental challenge in computer vision. In this work, we introduce a framework that enhances geometric alignment for monocular view synthesis under drastic camera changes by jointly generating a target view and its corresponding depth map. By conditioning the diffusion pipeline on the single source image, source depth, and target camera rays, our approach forces the model to inherently reason in 3D space even under extreme viewpoint shifts. To guarantee spatial fidelity, we propose a novel per-pixel depth consistency constraint, which verifies and enforces 3D consistency across generated views. Our framework establishes a robust pipeline for geometrically consistent view synthesis, yielding superior visual accuracy and spatial alignment compared to current state-of-the-art methods. With this work, we pave the road towards robust 3D world models capable of understanding complex environments from a single view image.
paragraphs.zh: 该研究提出结合深度图联合生成的扩散框架，利用逐像素深度一致性约束实现几何一致的新视角合成。从2D扩散模型生成具有3D一致性的新视角，仍然是计算机视觉领域的一项根本性挑战。 在本工作中，我们提出一个框架，通过联合生成目标视角及其对应的深度图，来增强剧烈相机变化下单目视角合成的几何对齐。 通过以单张源图像、源深度和目标相机光线为条件来引导扩散流程，我们的方法迫使模型即使在极端视点偏移下也能在3D空间中进行内在推理。 为保证空间保真度，我们提出一种新颖的逐像素深度一致性约束，用于验证并强制生成视角之间的3D一致性。 我们的框架建立了一个用于几何一致视角合成的稳健流程，与当前最先进的方法相比，能够带来更优的视觉精度和空间对齐效果。 通过这项工作，我们为构建能够从单张视角图像理解复杂环境的稳健3D世界模型铺平了道路。
